app.name: DRG Driver
app.tagline: Aplikasi komunitas driver ojek online Driver Riang Gembira (DRG)
app.audience: Driver ojek online & pengurus komunitas DRG

phases.title: Fase 1 — Fondasi Komunitas & Darurat
phases.summary: Arsitektur Clean MVI + Compose M3, Room local-first, SOS/CrashGuard, Radar OSM, Kas Transparan, Forum, KTA Digital, dan RBAC.

phases.title: Fase 2 — Komunikasi P2P Serverless & Cloud Production
phases.summary: 2-way Firestore sync + LWW CRDT, Firebase AI Logic, FCM topic P2P discovery & self-host socket, adaptive icon PNG, anti-tamper integrity, dan CI/CD release OTA.

phases.title: Fase 3 — Layanan Finansial & Kemitraan
phases.summary: Marketplace kebutuhan operasional driver (deferred di luar scope rilis awal).

features.name: Autentikasi & Onboarding
features.description: Landing 360°, Google Sign-In tunggal (Credential Manager), registrasi KTA tertaut Google UID, dan area dropdown.

features.name: Dashboard Driver
features.description: Ringkasan status shift, statistik komunitas, onboarding progresif, dan aksi cepat.

features.name: Radar Live & Peta
features.description: Peta OpenStreetMap, radar driver, tile LRU cache, mode Google Maps, dan manajemen hazard.

features.name: Darurat SOS & CrashGuard
features.description: Tombol panik SOS, sensor tabrakan akselerometer, sirine desibel tinggi, dan fallback SMS darurat.

features.name: Kas Transparan
features.description: Pembukuan kas masuk/keluar, saldo bersih, dan laporan transparansi komunitas.

features.name: Forum & Bengkel Rekanan
features.description: Diskusi internal, update jalur, komentar berantai, dan direktori bengkel rekanan.

features.name: Direktori Anggota & Posko
features.description: Direktori anggota terverifikasi, manajemen posko, check-in, dan manajemen peran.

features.name: KTA Digital & Profil
features.description: KTA digital dengan QR & watermark holografik, biodata lengkap, dan progres loyalitas.

features.name: Misi, Poin & Loyalitas
features.description: Leaderboard, badge, misi komunitas, riwayat poin, dan penukaran reward.

features.name: Pusat Kendali & Governance
features.description: Verifikasi screening anggota, broadcast pengumuman, audit log otorisasi, dan kesehatan sistem.

features.name: Hub Komunitas
features.description: Pusat navigasi sub-tab komunitas (kas, forum, anggota, misi, acara & klaim).

features.name: Notifikasi & Pengaturan
features.description: Pusat notifikasi, preferensi push, pengaturan cache, baterai, dan lokasi.

features.name: Layanan Driver (PTT, AI, Proteksi)
features.description: Walkie-talkie PTT, asisten AI Gemini, proteksi, escort satgas, dan koperasi wholesale.

features.name: Navigasi & Shell Aplikasi
features.description: Shell Compose, bottom navigation, header, dialog global, dan manajemen tab.

features.name: Database Local-First (Room v14)
features.description: Room v14 dengan 26 tabel, DAO reaktif, dan migrasi eksplisit v1→v14.

features.name: Map Tile LRU Cache
features.description: Caching tile peta LRU hemat data & baterai, dengan kebijakan cache adaptif.

features.name: Hemat Baterai & Data
features.description: Power saver, data saver, dan penjadwal sinkronisasi sadar baterai.

features.name: Sinkronisasi Offline & CRDT
features.description: BackgroundSyncEngine ke Cloud Firestore + fallback lokal + rekonsiliasi LWW CRDT conflict-free.

features.name: Deteksi Tabrakan
features.description: Monitor akselerometer untuk deteksi guncangan/tabrakan dan pemicu CrashGuard.

features.name: GPS & Location Sharing
features.description: Location provider, berbagi koordinat live, dan profil daya lokasi.

features.name: Audio Route & Alarm
features.description: Routing audio (speaker/alarm) dan manajer alarm sirine SOS.

features.name: Firebase (Firestore, Auth, FCM, AI)
features.description: Integrasi 2-way Cloud Firestore, Google Auth Credential Manager, FCM PTT/P2P, dan Firebase AI Logic.

features.name: RBAC & Role Audit Trail
features.description: RoleManager, validasi perubahan peran, dan audit trail otorisasi immutable.

features.name: P2P Serverless & FCM Discovery
features.description: WebRTC DataChannel, discovery FCM topic + Firestore signaling, dan self-host TCP/HTTP listener.

features.name: Adaptive Icon & Branding
features.description: Adaptive icon SVG/layer-list + PNG 5 densitas (mdpi-xxxhdpi square & circular-masked) serta tema terang konsisten.

features.name: App Check, Integrity & Anti-Tamper
features.description: Firebase App Check, verifikasi digest sertifikat/installer/anti-hook runtime, R8 obfuscation, dan PIN PBKDF2 Keystore.

features.name: Release Signing, Delta OTA & CI/CD
features.description: Pipeline CI/CD GitHub Actions, Release AAB/APK signing, BSDIFF40 delta patch, dan SHA-256 updater.

features.name: Halaman Tentang & Roadmap Otomatis
features.description: Tree fitur, progres pengembangan jujur, fase pengerjaan, dan rencana penyempurnaan — digenerate otomatis dari kode.

plannedFeatures.name: Marketplace Kebutuhan Operasional
plannedFeatures.description: [DEFERRED — di luar scope rilis awal. Finansial komunitas sementara hanya iuran kas (Kas Transparan phase-1). Jangan dianggap blocker.] Oli, ban, helm, jas hujan langsung dari distributor resmi dengan diskon anggota.

refinements.title: Firebase AI Logic Production
refinements.detail: Asisten AI menggunakan Firebase.ai (gemini-3.8-flash) tanpa API key client hardcoded.

refinements.title: KtLint & Line-Cap Check di CI
refinements.detail: check_file_length.py (<125 baris) + ktlint static analysis berjalan otomatis di android_ci.yml.

refinements.title: Verifikasi Migrasi Room v1→v14
refinements.detail: Schema JSON 1-14 lengkap di app/schemas/ dan AppDatabaseMigrationTest lolos.

refinements.title: Instrumented UI Tests (Device/Emulator)
refinements.detail: Opsional di perangkat/emulator eksternal: tambah cakupan androidTest UI alur login, SOS, kas.

refinements.title: Dokumentasi Publik
refinements.detail: Situs dokumentasi (GitHub Pages) untuk pengurus & developer.
